integrity.priority: Best-knowledge literature comparison, not a historical uniqueness certificate.
integrity.verification: Exact symbolic determinant and adjugate comparison plus independently solved joint-chain rational cases.

scientific_limitations: The model uses external, non-self-consistent colonization and one binary patch; it does not establish persistence of closed finite metapopulations.
The exact three-state sign classification is not asserted for larger state spaces or transient populations.
A broader stochastic-matrix or Markov-modulated reward identity could subsume the formula; one relevant 2004 full text was inaccessible.
title: A circulation–area law for occupation under three-stage habitat succession
